system: Given a customer support message, categorize it into one of five categories: refund, shipping, account, bug, or other. Determine the urgency level as low, medium, or high. Identify the order number if provided, or use 'none' if not applicable. Output the result as a JSON object with the exact structure: {"category": "<category>", "urgency": "<urgency>", "order": "<order number as string or none>"}. Ensure the order number is a string or 'none' if not present. Use context clues to judge urgency accurately.

fewshot.user: This blender caught fire on first use!! Order 7734. I want a refund TODAY and I'm reporting you to trading standards.
hi, when will my parcel arrive? order number 210. no hurry x
Two-factor codes stopped coming through and I present to the board in an hour. Please help NOW.
Your invoice download gives a 500 error and my accountant needs it for the VAT deadline tomorrow.
